messages.content: 從紐約到洛杉磯的最短駕駛里程是多少英里，再從洛杉磯到邁阿密，考慮到你必須從邁阿密返回紐約？

function.name: get_shortest_driving_distance
function.description: Calculate the shortest driving distance between two locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: Preferred unit of distance (optional, default is kilometers).

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "From New York to Los Angeles the shortest driving distance in miles, then from Los Angeles to Miami, considering you must return from Miami to New York?" They want distances. We need to compute shortest driving distance between NYC and LA, then LA to Miami, then Miami back to NY? Actually they say "from Los Angeles to Miami, considering you must return from Miami to New York". So maybe they want total distance: NYC->LA + LA->Miami + Miami->NYC. But question ambiguous: "from Los Angeles to Miami, considering you must return from Miami to New York?" Might mean they want LA->Miami distance, but also consider that you will have to go back from Miami to New York. So maybe they want LA->Miami distance plus Miami->NYC distance? Or just ask for LA->Miami distance? The phrase "considering you must return from Miami to New York" suggests we should include that leg too. So answer: NYC->LA shortest driving distance ~2,450 miles. LA->Miami ~2,800 miles. Miami->NYC ~1,300 miles. Total ~6,550 miles.

We can use the function get_shortest_driving_distance. Let's call it twice: NYC to LA, LA to Miami, Miami to NYC. Then sum. Use unit miles.
